column3: “the Midianites would come up with the Amalekites” renders “Midian and Amalek … went up”; “them” renders “him.”
“the earth” renders “the land”; “as far as Gaza” renders “until you come to Gaza.”
“on account of” renders “concerning the causes of.”
“a prophet” renders “a man, a prophet”; “the house of slavery” renders “a house of slaves.”
“hands” renders the Hebrew singular “hand”; “the Egyptians” renders “Egypt.”
“as” renders “and”; “to save it from” renders “to hide it from.”
“O my lord” renders “Pardon me, my lord”; “miracles” renders “wonders.”
“O Lord” renders “Pardon me, O Lord”; “the least” renders “the weakest,” and “the youngest” renders “the least.”
“unleavened bread from an ephah of flour” renders “an ephah of flour of unleavened bread”; “presented” renders “brought near.”
“vanished from his sight” renders “went from his eyes.”
“the same night” renders “that night”; “Asherah” renders “Asherah pole.” The Hebrew of the first clause is difficult.
“stronghold” renders “place of refuge”; “in an orderly manner” renders “in the row.”
